name: sky.money USDT Savings
oneLiner: skyMoneyUsdtSavings is a Sky.money-curated Morpho lending vault over USDT; interest and losses change its share value, and exits depend on liquidity.
collateral: USDT held idle or supplied through Sky.money-curated Morpho lending markets
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares represent a pro-rata USDT-denominated claim on idle tokens and Morpho lender positions. Interest accrual and realized losses change the exchange rate; redeem/withdraw delivers USDT when vault and market liquidity allow.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Ethereum deployment 0x23f5e9c35820f4bab695ac1f19c203cc3f8e1e11 is an immutable Morpho Vault V2 lender share over USDT. The holder has an operational pro-rata vault claim, not direct title to borrower collateral or a fiat claim. Its local conservation, allocation and recovery mechanics differ from the tracked parent. This is the implementation launch, not issuer founding or parent-token launch.
